searchText: Were there any issues today with the merge ignoring the misconfigured validators? Seems like that was the major problem? Hash rate = mining yield. New miners will quickly join when yield raises, as ETH does not demand special hardware for mining. Lone wolf miner attack in between? ETH PoS staking will be dumb not to work with ETH foundation to secure mine rigs during that transition to keep hash rate stable so to avoid potential attacks That was the main issue, other than that clients seem to have no other noticeable issues with the merge
